product_metadata.title: MrLifeHack 3D Illusion Night Light Modern Bedside Mood Lamp - Color Changing LED - Cool, Decorative and Great for Kids - USB and Wall Plug Included
features: COLOR CHANGING: Get the mood just right with our 3D Illusion Night Light. Easily toggle between 7 different colors ( Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Light Blue, Purple, Fluorescent or White) or use the Rainbow Mode where colors pulsate. Impress guests with this unique design which easily outshines outdated lamps.

VERSATILE DECOR: This beautiful Modern Lamp will brighten up any space from the bedroom, living room, kitchen, nursery, cafe, store, office, you name it. Putting this versatile lamp bedside, on a desk, table, floor or any where else you can think of will instantly bring style, calm, and positive energy to that room.

LET THERE BE LIGHT: Our 3D Illusion Night Light lamp can help babies, toddlers, kids, and even adults who are scared of the dark. The soothing glow can help you fall asleep and light the halls for late night bathroom runs. This nightlight is both decorative & functional.

SAVE TIME & ENERGY: Never waste time with complicated remotes & controls again. Our smart touch button lets you easily turn the lamp on/off and toggle through colors. Not only is it easy to use but this energy efficient LED lamp won't run up your electric bill.

A GREAT GIFT: This 3D Meditation Lamp makes an amazing gift for girls, boys,teens, birthdays, holidays, housewarmings and any other occasion you can think of. Usb cable & wall Plug included. Get your dose of zen, relax & let our products work for you!
